entities.name: Isareth the Awakener
entities.description: A legendary human wizard, former queen and high priest, who now rules the realm of the dead.

events.summary: Isareth's subjects rose against her; her family was killed but she escaped into the catacombs.
events.quote: Her family was killed, but Isareth escaped into the catacombs of the city.

events.summary: Isareth came to rule the realm of the dead.
events.quote: Now she rules over a different realm, the realm of the dead
